QuestInfo.name: [RED] Lost a Ring, Gained an Enemy
QuestInfo.0: You lost the #b#t1113068##k you got for reaching Lv. 70. You'll need a new one to upgrade to the #t1113069#. Go talk to Cassandra.
QuestInfo.1: You lost the #b#t1113068##k you got for reaching Lv. 70. You'll need a new one to upgrade to the #t1113069#. But Cassandra is not happy about it! She will only give you a new one if you #eeliminate 999 monsters around your level#n.
QuestInfo.2: You got yourself a new #b#t1113068##k by fighting about a million monsters. Cassandra seems to have forgiven you... Or has she?

0.0: Oh, no... NO. Did you seriously lose that #e#b#t1113068##k#n?! Oh my gosh, the shipping on those things alone takes like a month! Ugh. I just HAPPEN to have another one, but it's gonna cost you #b#e100,000 mesos#k#n, AND I get to make fun of you until the next patch. Deal?
0.1: Actually, NO. Here's my offer. You go through boot camp to apologize for disrespecting my perfect and amazing gift-giving skills, and you can have another one.

yes.0: I worked hard to get that ring in the first place, so you're gonna have to work hard to get it back. Hunt #r#e999 monsters#k#n around your level, THEN you can have it.

1.0: Ugh, did you actually do it? I'm still super mad at you, but FINE. Here's your ring.

yes.0: I still can't believe you could lose something so valuable!
